recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If PA still wants the separately mentioned failureAction search parameter, handle that as follow-up work in HL7/admin-incubator rather than reintroducing VerificationResult search-parameter source in core.
issue_request: FHIR-19972 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification disposition for R5. It requested a VerificationResult status/validation-status search parameter based on VhDir, the related VhDir VerificationResult search parameters, and a parameter for VerificationResult.failureAction.
initial_application: PA minutes and the Jira snapshot record the 2022-05-10 PA approval vote. Git commit ff10b006c1456486914c3531a305eb971b6d778f applied the issue in core by adding VhDir-derived entries to source/verificationresult/bundle-VerificationResult-search-params.xml: attestation-method, attestation-onbehalfof, attestation-who, primarysource-date, primarysource-type, primarysource-who, status-date, validation-status, and validator-organization. The historical file did not include a failureAction search parameter.
additional_context: VerificationResult is no longer part of the current core FHIR build. Commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed source/verificationresult and its fhir.ini build entries, and current ballot/history source points VerificationResult to HL7/admin-incubator. The external admin-incubator source has the migrated VerificationResult search-parameter bundle, including validation-status, but no failureAction SearchParameter was found there.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The published commit is an empty external-repo audit because the affected source is now outside this checkout and outside the current core build.
